# S46 — Dependency trim and version alignment (no new dependencies)

**Findings:** app/build.gradle:51-61 (appcompat, material, compose material M2 unused; lifecycle 2.6.2 vs 2.8.2); app/build.gradle:1-5 (stale comment) · **Size:** S · **Tree:** release

**2026-10-03** — S04's review note says lintDebug reports 52 version/catalog warnings (0 errors), left for S19. After the roadmap split those belong here: run ./gradlew lintDebug before and after this slice, and record the warning count in the closing note (use the lint report under app/build/reports/ to see which are outdated-dependency warnings).

**Not in this slice:** adding any dependency, upgrading Kotlin or Compose, raising compile or target SDK (S48), R8 (S19) and signing (S47).

## Why

- The dependency list carries artifacts the code does not use, which grows the APK and the F-Droid review surface: `appcompat`, `com.google.android.material` (only the XML theme parent used it, and S11 removes that), and Compose Material 2 (`androidx.compose.material:material`).
- Lifecycle artifacts are on different versions (2.6.2 and 2.8.2).
- Versions are pinned inline instead of in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`, and a stale comment at the top of `app/build.gradle` says so.

## Files

- `app/build.gradle`
- `gradle/libs.versions.toml`
- `app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml`, `values-night/themes.xml` (read only: confirm S11 already removed the `MaterialComponents` parent)

## Failing tests

- None. The build and unit tests are the check.

## Implement

1. Record the baseline: `./gradlew :app:dependencies --configuration releaseRuntimeClasspath > before.txt` (keep it outside the repo or in the scratchpad), and note the debug APK size.
2. Confirm each removal candidate is unused: `rg -n "androidx.appcompat|com.google.android.material|androidx.compose.material\\." app/src`. The only acceptable hits are `androidx.compose.material.icons` (that is the icons library, which stays) and `androidx.compose.material3`. Also confirm no theme still uses `Theme.MaterialComponents`.
3. Remove `appcompat`, `com.google.android.material:material` and `androidx.compose.material:material` from `app/build.gradle`.
4. Align the lifecycle artifacts to one version (2.8.2 for both `lifecycle-runtime-ktx` and `lifecycle-viewmodel-compose`).
5. Move the remaining versions into `gradle/libs.versions.toml` and reference them as `libs.…` from `app/build.gradle`, keeping the currently resolved versions. Do not upgrade anything unless the build forces it. Keep `androidx.core:core-ktx` at 1.12.0 until S48 (newer releases need a higher compile SDK). Delete the "NOTE: dependency versions…" comment block.
6. Remove unused entries from the catalog (`espresso`, `junit` aliases that nothing references) only if `rg` shows nothing uses them.
7. Run the baseline command again and compare.

## Check

- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` passes.
- The app launches and every screen renders (including a dark-mode check).
- Record the dependency count and APK size before and after with `slicer note S46`.
